deliverables: Open standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
Documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from verified interface definitions
MCP server for agents to discover and call published protocols
12 additional protocol onboardings over 12 months, described as 3 per quarter
Shared infrastructure for all protocols on the Tx3 Protocol Registry
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe.
request.what: Fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols, including developer and agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.

The stated purpose is to deliver an open, standardized interface across leading Cardano on-chain protocols so developers and AI agents can discover, integrate, and compose them through one consistent surface.
The proposer says Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across protocols, causing integrators to relearn protocols, rebuild understanding, and face higher integration costs.
The proposer says Tx3 describes each protocol once with a verified interface definition that produces documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
The document states that Catalyst Fund 14 has already put the Tx3 developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal commits to funding 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposer says the work aligns with Intersect Pillar 2 for Adoption and Utility through developer experience and open-source incentives.
The document states the proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The document states the requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The document says funds will be administered through Intersect using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization rules, oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month TxPipe Tx3 project to expand standardized developer and AI-agent interfaces for Cardano protocols, with stated deliverables around additional protocol onboardings, MCP/skills infrastructure, SDKs, RPC endpoints, Intersect process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based treasury administration.
